prompt: a riverside mill town with a market square, a watchtower on the hill and tanneries kept downwind

card.name: Riverside Mill Town

site.text: a riverside town on a river bank, with a hill rising behind it for the watchtower

style.text: plain, unspecified; cozy working-town look in wood, stone and thatch

purpose.text: mill town with a market square, working trades and a lookout

program.notes: Waterwheel in the river, grain mill with hoppers and a loading door; the town's centrepiece.
Open-fronted stalls around a square with a well.
Tall lookout on the hill with a beacon brazier, overlooking the river.
Drying racks and cauldron vats, downwind and downstream at the far edge of town.
Homes of millers, traders and tanners, clustered near the square.
Stores flour and grain from the mills.
Inn by the bridge or landing.

card.interpretation: A medium waterfront town on a river bank. The mills sit on the water, the market square is at the heart, the watchtower stands on a hill, and the tanneries are at the far edge downwind and downstream from the homes and market. Style was not given, so I used a rustic working-town look.
assumptions: Style is rustic since none was named.
Existing terrain with a river and hill will be searched for, not sculpted.
Wind is not modelled, so 'downwind' is read as the far edge of town, downstream.
Added a granary barn and tavern to round out a mill town.

meta.note: placement hints: mills and tavern near_water, stalls central, watchtower high_ground, tannery and granary edge
